name: Player prop / prop combo
signal: Price a player's points, rebounds and assists, and their combos, against a posted line. Requires a per-game minutes distribution and a within-player correlation; neither is reachable, so no bet is ever generated.
thresholds_note: every value is a module constant in nba2/v2/strategy_lab.py, not a fitted-on-the-test-set number; the file's own sha256 is recorded below so a change to any of them breaks this hash

universe.games: every official regular-season game in the committed results feed
universe.window: every official regular-season game in the committed results feed. The feed grows as results are ingested; the rule does not change with it.
universe.eligibility: a game is eligible once BOTH clubs have appeared in a strictly earlier game, so every rating is built only from prior results

exclusions.no_prior_data: games on the first date of the feed (no rating exists yet)
exclusions.neutral_site: excluded from S4 only, where the home-fade signal is meaningless without a home team
exclusions.S3: games whose |predicted margin| is below 5 pts
exclusions.S4: games the model does not make the home side an underdog of 3+ pts, and neutral-site games
exclusions.S6: dates with fewer than two eligible games (a parlay needs two legs)
exclusions.S7: every game: no per-player data exists, so no bet is ever generated

universe.no_cherry_picking: the universe is defined by the rule, not by the results; no game is added or removed after its outcome is known

rules.win: the player's official box-score figure is strictly on the side taken
rules.loss: the figure is strictly on the other side
rules.push: the figure equals the line exactly, OR the player does not appear in the official box score for that game (a non-appearance voids the bet)

settlement.grading_time: a bet is graded after the game's official status is FINAL and the result has been read off two official surfaces; a game with only one captured surface is not settled
